changes.title: In Maine, Troy Jackson Gains Momentum in Bid to Replace Platner
changes.summary: Troy Jackson, a progressive former State Senate president, showed signs of significant strength, as half the state’s counties picked delegates to a convention where they will choose Graham Platner’s replacement.

changes.title: Shenna Bellows drops out of Maine’s Senate race as Troy Jackson builds Democratic support
changes.summary: Former state Senate President Troy Jackson is racking up support to become Maine’s next Democratic Senate nominee, with one of his top opponents, Shenna Bellows, ending her campaign on Sunday.

changes.title: Maine Democrat Shenna Bellows drops out of race to replace Graham Platner
changes.summary: SANFORD, Maine — Maine Secretary of State Shenna Bellows ended her Senate campaign on Sunday, further clearing the path for rival Troy Jackson as he consolidates support in a fast-moving Democratic nomination contest. changes.title: In Maine, Bellows Ends Senate Bid, as Jackson Builds Momentum
changes.summary: The Maine secretary of state ended her run in a crowded race to replace Graham Platner as the Democratic Senate nominee.

changes.title: Homan says "I think body cameras are the way to go" after ICE shootings
changes.summary: White House border czar Tom Homan said "I think body cameras are the way to go" after fatal shootings by federal immigration officers in Texas and Maine earlier this month.

changes.title: Troy Jackson has effectively secured the Maine Senate Democratic nomination
changes.summary: SANFORD, Maine — Troy Jackson has effectively secured the Democratic nomination in the crucial Maine Senate race, winning the support of a majority of the state delegates who will officially nominate a candidate next weekend. changes.title: In Maine Senate Race, Jackson Sprints Ahead of Pack, as Bellows Drops Out
changes.summary: Troy Jackson, a progressive, solidified his edge over his rivals in an abbreviated nominating contest to replace Graham Platner. Shenna Bellows, another candidate, bowed out.

changes.title: ICE officer in Maine shooting has history of violent behavior, relatives say
changes.summary: The Immigration and Customs Enforcement officer who shot and killed a Colombian man in Maine this week is an Army veteran who has struggled with serious mental health issues since early childhood, relatives say.
